text_ja: 第六条第二項第四号並びに第七条第二項第四号及び第六号に掲げる額は、次に定めるところにより算出した額とする。一第六条第二項第四号に掲げるその他金融機関等のその他Tier1資本調達手段の額は、その他金融機関等(次に掲げる者をいう。)の対象資本等調達手段を最終指定親会社等が保有している場合(連結範囲外の法人等に対する投資その他これに類する行為を通じて当該最終指定親会社等が実質的に保有している場合に相当すると認められる場合その他これに準ずる場合を含み、第六項各号の場合を除く。)における当該対象資本等調達手段(以下この条において「その他金融機関等に係る対象資本等調達手段」という。)のうちその他Tier1資本調達手段に相当するものの額とする。イ当該最終指定親会社等がその総株主等の議決権の百分の十を超える議決権を保有している他の金融機関等ロ連結財務諸表規則第五条第一項各号に該当するため、連結自己資本規制比率の算出に当たり連結の範囲に含まれない金融子会社(イに掲げる者を除く。)ハ当該最終指定親会社が銀行又は銀行法第五十二条の二十三第一項第一号から第十号まで若しくは第十五号に掲げる会社(同項第十号に掲げる会社のうち同号イに掲げる業務を専ら営むものを除く。以下この号において「金融業務を営む会社」という。)を子会社等としている場合における当該子会社等であって、連結財務諸表規則第五条第一項各号又は第二項に該当するため、連結自己資本規制比率の算出に当たり連結の範囲に含まれないもの(イ及びロに掲げる者を除く。)ニ当該最終指定親会社が金融業務を営む会社を関連会社等としている場合における当該関連会社等(次条において「金融業務を営む関連会社等」という。)(イに掲げる者を除く。)二第七条第二項第四号に掲げるその他金融機関等のTier2資本調達手段の額は、その他金融機関等に係る対象資本等調達手段のうちTier2資本調達手段に相当するものの額とする。三第七条第二項第六号に掲げるその他金融機関等のその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額は、その他金融機関等に係る対象資本等調達手段のうちその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額とする。
text_en: The amounts set forth in Article 6, paragraph (2), item (iv) and Article 7, paragraph (2), items (iv) and (vi) shall be calculated as follows. (i) The amount of Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments of other financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 6, paragraph (2), item (iv) shall be the amount of target capital, etc. instruments (hereinafter referred to as "target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc." in this Article) of other financial institutions, etc. (meaning the following persons) held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. (including cases deemed equivalent to constructive holding through investments in non-consolidated juridical persons, etc., but excluding cases falling under each item of paragraph (6)) that are equivalent to Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments. (a) Other financial institutions, etc. in which the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. holds more than 10% of the total voting rights of all shareholders, etc. (b) Financial subsidiaries not included in the scope of consolidation because they fall under each item of Article 5, paragraph (1) of the Consolidated Financial Statements Regulation (excluding those set forth in (a)). (c) Subsidiaries, etc. of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company that are banks or companies set forth in Article 52-23, paragraph (1), items (i) through (x) or item (xv) of the Banking Act (excluding companies set forth in item (x) of such paragraph that exclusively engage in the business set forth in item (a) thereof; hereinafter referred to as "companies engaged in financial business" in this item) that are not included in the scope of consolidation because they fall under each item or paragraph (2) of Article 5, paragraph (1) of the Consolidated Financial Statements Regulation (excluding those set forth in (a) and (b)). (d) Affiliated companies, etc. of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company that are companies engaged in financial business (hereinafter referred to as "affiliated companies, etc. engaged in financial business" in the following Article) (excluding those set forth in (a)). (ii) The amount of Tier 2 Capital instruments of other financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 7, paragraph (2), item (iv) shall be the amount of target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc. that are equivalent to Tier 2 Capital instruments. (iii) The amount of other external TLAC-related instruments of other financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 7, paragraph (2), item (vi) shall be the amount of other external TLAC-related instruments among the target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc.

二第七条第二項第四号に掲げるその他金融機関等のTier2資本調達手段の額は、その他金融機関等に係る対象資本等調達手段のうちTier2資本調達手段に相当するものの額とする。

clauses_en.text: The amounts set forth in Article 6, paragraph (2), item (iv) and Article 7, paragraph (2), items (iv) and (vi) shall be calculated as follows.

(i) The amount of Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments of other financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 6, paragraph (2), item (iv) shall be the amount of target capital, etc. instruments (hereinafter referred to as "target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc." in this Article) of other financial institutions, etc. (meaning the following persons) held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. (including cases deemed equivalent to constructive holding through investments in non-consolidated juridical persons, etc., but excluding cases under each item of paragraph (6)) that are equivalent to Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments. (a) Other financial institutions, etc. in which the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. holds more than 10% of total voting rights. (b) Financial subsidiaries not included in the scope of consolidation because they fall under each item of Article 5, paragraph (1) of the Consolidated Financial Statements Regulation (excluding those in (a)). (c) Subsidiaries, etc. that are banks or companies under Article 52-23, paragraph (1), items (i)-(x) or (xv) of the Banking Act (excluding companies under item (x) that exclusively conduct the business in item (i)(a) thereof; hereinafter "companies engaged in financial business") not included in the scope of consolidation because they fall under each item or paragraph (2) of Article 5, paragraph (1) of the Consolidated Financial Statements Regulation (excluding those in (a) and (b)). (d) Affiliated companies, etc. of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company that are companies engaged in financial business (hereinafter "affiliated companies, etc. engaged in financial business" in the following Article) (excluding those in (a)).

(ii) The amount of Tier 2 Capital instruments of other financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 7, paragraph (2), item (iv) shall be the amount of target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc. that are equivalent to Tier 2 Capital instruments.

(iii) The amount of other external TLAC-related instruments of other financial institutions, etc. set forth in Article 7, paragraph (2), item (vi) shall be the amount of other external TLAC-related instruments among the target capital, etc. instruments of other financial institutions, etc.
